recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Further core edits are not needed unless the work group decides to revise the subscription delivery-error guidance more broadly.
issue_request: FHIR-43516 was an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-I R6 change request noting that subscription notification delivery limitations were repeated in the overview and scoping sections, with a resolution to align conformance wording and link the scoping text to Detecting Delivery Errors.
initial_application: Commit 7c3db028d766e3d50f1b3f20aa6096e361db2cb3 applied FHIR-43516 in source/subscriptions.html by removing the overview duplicate in favor of a Scoping Responsibilities cross-reference, updating nearby subscriber SHOULD wording, and adding the Detecting Delivery Errors link to the scoping warning. Jira's only comment points to merged HL7/fhir PR #3967, which contains that application commit.
additional_context: source/subscriptions.html is in current build scope through publish.ini and source/hierarchy.xml. FHIR-I WGM minutes for 2024-02-01 record FHIR-43516 as Persuasive with a 14-0-0 motion. A Zulip subscriptions ballot thread mentions FHIR-43516 as one of several shared R6/backport issues and records the editor's guidance that one tracker was sufficient for synchronizing shared content. No conflicting community evidence was found.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current overview points readers to Scoping Responsibilities instead of repeating the limitation warning, and the scoping section contains the limitation bullets plus the requested Detecting Delivery Errors link.
